; Experimental QMD v7: landscape-only crop, no extra rotation.
; FBController remains a direct syntactic child of mainWindowView for AppLoad's
; built-in QMD selector, but its visual parent changes to the full-size content
; item only for the dedicated VNSee test app in fullscreen mode.
AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Rectangle#mainWindowView
        LOCATE BEFORE FBController#windowCanvas
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: vnseeClipViewport
                visible: windowCanvas.vnseeClipMode
                width: 960
                height: 720
                clip: true
                property real vnseeClipScale: Math.min(parent.width / 960, parent.height / 720)
                x: (parent.width - 960 * vnseeClipScale) / 2
                y: (parent.height - 720 * vnseeClipScale) / 2
                transformOrigin: Item.TopLeft
                rotation: 0
                scale: vnseeClipScale

                Item {
                    id: vnseeClipContent
                    width: 1620
                    height: 2160
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Rectangle#mainWindowView > FBController#windowCanvas
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool vnseeClipMode: root.appName === "VNSee asivery Test" && root.fullscreen && mainWindowView.width > mainWindowView.height
            parent: vnseeClipMode ? vnseeClipContent : mainWindowView
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
